item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena finds four transparent curved objects in her grandfather's old spectacle kit at home in Jaipur. She measures how the thickness of each object changes from its middle to its edge.
Which object is a convex lens?

options.A: a glass piece that is thinner in the middle than at the edges
options.B: a glass piece that is thicker in the middle than at the edges
options.C: a glass piece that has the same thickness in the middle and at the edges
options.D: a glass piece that is curved but thicker on one side than the other
